answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 25 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The relic debit happens at intake, ferrous totals the burned amount, and lantern anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 101 pays that 108 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
